reviewItem.question: Does "Namespaced composite resources: Crossplane v2 makes composite resources (XRs) namespaced by default" mean a change to crd-field:crossplane|group=apiextensions.crossplane.io|version=v2|kind=CompositeResourceDefinition|path=spec.scope (added)?

proposed.statement: Crossplane v2 makes composite resources (XRs) namespaced by default, with a new `scope` field on CompositeResourceDefinition (XRD) that defaults to `Namespaced` in v2 API and XR machinery moved under `spec.crossplane`; v1-style XRDs in `LegacyCluster` mode remain backward compatible without claims support in v2.
